title: Schedule — Regional Sales Conference, Hotel Arcadia · E-mail · To: Conference participants · From: Ingrid Holm · Date: September 15
L: (1) Schedule — Regional Sales Conference, Hotel Arcadia
9:00 A.M. — Welcome speech — Ingrid Holm, Sales Director (Ballroom)
10:00 A.M. — Workshop: Negotiating with large clients — Victor Osei (Room 2)
1:30 P.M. — Workshop: Using data to find new customers — Amy Ng (Room 3)
3:30 P.M. — Panel discussion: The future of retail (Ballroom)
(2) E-mail · To: Conference participants · From: Ingrid Holm · Date: September 15
Dear colleagues, I look forward to seeing you all on Thursday.
Please note one change to the schedule: Amy Ng's workshop will now take place in the Ballroom instead of Room 3, as more than sixty people have registered for it.
Also, because of renovation work, lunch will be served in the hotel restaurant rather than outdoors.
Please remember to bring your laptops for the afternoon workshop.

exq.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
exq.a: To announce changes to some session arrangements
w: To announce that a speaker has canceled
To ask attendees to sign up for workshops in advance
To report that the conference will move to another hotel
exq.why: Please note one change to the schedule…

og.To announce changes to some session arra: Để báo thay đổi về sắp xếp một số phần của hội nghị
og.To announce that a speaker has canceled: Để báo một diễn giả đã huỷ
og.To ask attendees to sign up for workshop: Để đề nghị người dự đăng ký hội thảo trước
og.To report that the conference will move: Để báo hội nghị chuyển sang khách sạn khác

lg.dich: Xin lưu ý một thay đổi về lịch trình.

exq.a: Many people signed up for it.
exq.why: more than sixty people have registered for it.

lg.ly: Hơn sáu mươi người đăng ký nên buổi của bà Ng được chuyển sang Ballroom rộng hơn.
lg.dich: Buổi workshop của bà Ng sẽ chuyển sang Ballroom thay vì Phòng 3, vì hơn sáu mươi người đã đăng ký.
